text: On each puzzle, get the RED car out through the opening
Vehicles only slide along their own axis, and cannot pass
One car is outlined in white; the arrows on it show which ways
Cars that cannot move at all are skipped: choosing only ever
lands on a car with at least one arrow.
[A] / [S]  or  [3] / [4]          choose the previous / next car
[LEFT] / [RIGHT]              slide a horizontal car left / right
[UP] / [DOWN]                 slide a vertical car up / down
[1] or [Z]   /   [2] or [X]       slide it left or up / right or down
There are 49 puzzles. The first 12 get harder one by one;
after that, easy and hard ones come in any order.
Take all the time you need.
